name: Watch Them Spikes
author: intedgar
description:
Watch Them Spikes is a 3D Skill-Avoid Game in which you only have indirect control over the player through rotating the platform it's on. I never made it over Stage 7 myself. :D Can you beat my High Score?
It's my first own Project after finishing Unit 5 from the Programming Simple Functionality Mission in the Junior Programmer Pathway on Unity Learn.

Have fun playing! I'm happy to receive your feedback! You can also find a downloadable version for MS at https://intedgar.itch.io/watch-them-spikes
